en.headline: Anita Mui fan club says ashes urn missing from Po Lin Monastery since July
en.dek: On the late singer’s 63rd birthday the International Fan Club issued a statement that a fan found the niche empty on 18 July; police have been investigating for nearly three months.
body: The Anita Mui International Fan Club said on Saturday, which would have been the late singer’s 63rd birthday, that her ashes urn has been missing from a niche at the Hai Hui Pagoda of Po Lin Monastery on Lantau Island since mid-July.

According to the club’s statement, a fan visiting on 18 July noticed that the screws on the niche plate were loose and found the urn gone. The fan notified the family, who reported the matter to police. Nearly three months later the urn has not been recovered, the club said.

The statement appealed for information from anyone who visited the monastery or the pagoda between early January and mid-July, including dash-cam footage from July. It gave contact details for the Lantau District Crime Unit.

Mui’s elder brother, Mui Kai-ming, told reporters he had not been informed earlier and expressed surprise at the news. The club noted that the late singer’s mother had preferred a private, unmarked niche for her daughter.

zh.headline: 梅艷芳歌迷會指骨灰甕7月起在寶蓮禪寺失蹤
zh.dek: 周六為已故天后63歲冥壽，國際歌迷會發聲明稱7月18日歌迷發現海會塔靈位螺絲鬆脫、骨灰甕不翼而飛，報警近三個月仍未尋回。
body: 梅艷芳國際歌迷會周六（已故天后63歲冥壽）表示，安放於大嶼山寶蓮禪寺海會塔的梅艷芳骨灰甕自7月中起失蹤。
歌迷會聲明指出，7月18日有歌迷前往拜祭時發現存放骨灰位置的門牌螺絲鬆脫，內裏骨灰甕不見。歌迷通知家人後報警。至今近三個月仍未尋回。
聲明呼籲今年1月初至7月中旬曾到訪寶蓮禪寺或海會塔的市民提供線索，包括7月份車Cam畫面，並公布大嶼山警區重案組聯絡方法。
梅艷芳胞兄梅啟明接受訪問時表示事前不知情，對消息感到驚訝。歌迷會指當年梅媽希望女兒有私人空間，靈位並無貼上遺照。
